prompt: How does Copilot prevent stale memories from affecting agent behavior?
explanation: Per GitHub Docs, every memory has citations (code location references). Before use, Copilot validates them against the current branch. Invalid citations = memory discarded.

options.text: A nightly batch job deletes all memories
Citation-based validation — memory code references are checked against the current branch; mismatched citations cause the memory to be discarded
Memories are never used more than once
